paper_record.title: Demonstration of ultrafast coherent sub-picosecond magnon pulses
paper_record.abstract: Ultrafast magnonics explores routes towards energy-efficient information processing by replacing electrons with pulses of terahertz magnons. The critical, but so far elusive, requirement on the magnon pulses is the combination of high-speed and a long-range propagation while maintaining a well-defined narrow waveform of the pulses. Here, we demonstrate the launching of 0.4-picosecond magnon pulses in the altermagnetic insulator $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ (hematite) using broadband terahertz spin-orbit torques by an adjacent platinum layer. Phase-resolved terahertz transmission reveals that these sub-picosecond pulses travel ballistically, coherently and non-dispersively at a constant velocity of 23 nm/ps, transport angular momentum and retain their temporal waveform shape over 160 nm, with an inferred relaxation length in hundreds of nanometers or more. Beyond establishing $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ as an optimal platform for ultrafast magnonics, our technique introduces a high-resolution, tabletop method to directly extract dispersion relations up to high wavevectors, and explore ultrafast magnon dynamics in altermagnets and other magnetic materials with teraherz-range dynamics.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 在反铁磁绝缘体赤铁矿中实现了亚皮秒、相干且非色散的磁子脉冲的长距离弹道传输。
one_sentence_summary.en: Demonstration of long-range ballistic transport of sub-picosecond, coherent, and non-dispersive magnon pulses in the altermagnetic insulator hematite.

problem.zh: 实现高速磁子逻辑器件需要亚皮秒、相干且能长距离传输的磁子脉冲，但此前实验难以同时满足这些条件。
problem.en: Realizing high-speed magnon logic requires sub-picosecond, coherent magnon pulses capable of long-range propagation, which has remained elusive in previous experiments.

approach.zh: 利用相邻铂层中的太赫兹自旋轨道转矩对赤铁矿进行宽带相干激发，并通过相位分辨太赫兹透射技术进行探测。
approach.en: Broadband coherent excitation of hematite using terahertz spin-orbit torques from an adjacent platinum layer, probed via phase-resolved terahertz transmission.

main_takeaway.zh: 赤铁矿支持 0.4 皮秒的磁子脉冲以 23 nm/ps 的速度进行长距离弹道传输，且不发生几何展宽或色散。
main_takeaway.en: Hematite supports 0.4-ps magnon pulses that propagate ballistically over 160 nm at 23 nm/ps without measurable geometrical broadening or dispersion.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究克服了超快磁子学中的关键瓶颈，证明了赤铁矿是实现太赫兹时钟速率磁子逻辑器件的理想平台。
why_it_matters.en: This work overcomes a critical bottleneck in ultrafast magnonics, establishing hematite as an ideal platform for terahertz-clock-rate magnon logic devices.

reason.zh: 首次同时实现了亚皮秒、相干、非色散且长距离的磁子脉冲传输，为超快磁子学提供了实验基础。
reason.en: It provides the first experimental demonstration of simultaneously sub-picosecond, coherent, non-dispersive, and long-range magnon pulse transport, setting a new benchmark for ultrafast magnonics.

reason.zh: 该工作在超快磁子学领域具有突破性意义，且实验方法和结论符合顶级物理期刊的发表标准。
reason.en: The work represents a breakthrough in ultrafast magnonics, and the experimental methodology and findings align with the standards of top-tier physics journals.
